tools.name: comment_on_change_proposal
tools.description: Add a comment to a Change Proposal for the people reviewing it. This adds discussion but does not change any document.

tools.name: comment_on_document
tools.description: Leave a review comment on a selected passage in the open document. This does not change the document.

quotedText.description: Exact selected passage, at most 20,000 characters.

tools.name: explain_change_proposal
tools.description: Explain one Change Proposal with the exact before and suggested text for human review.

tools.name: explain_save
tools.description: Explain one save in plain language: who made it, when, what changed, and which files were involved.

number.description: The save's number from the timeline.

folder.description: Folder name. Leave off for the first folder.

tools.name: find_saves
tools.description: Search one folder's timeline by text in a save's label or by file path. Answers like “when did we touch the invoice?”.

query.description: Text to look for in labels or file paths.

folder.description: Folder name. Leave off for the first folder.

tools.name: get_document_history
tools.description: Read saves that mention the document currently open, newest first.

limit.description: Maximum entries, default 10 and at most 25.

tools.name: get_local_save_guidance
tools.description: Explain how to protect and save an existing folder on the local computer. Use this when someone asks to save or protect a local folder: the dashboard is not a save surface and this tool makes no changes.

tools.name: get_page_render_report
tools.description: Read what happened when the web page currently open was rendered in the dashboard: which files beside it were used, which it asked for and did not find, and any errors its own scripts reported. Use this after proposing a change to a web page. This never changes the folder.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Read a folder's timeline of saves, newest first. Each entry says who saved it, what changed in plain language, and which files mattered most.

folder.description: Folder name. Leave off for the first folder.

tools.name: get_workspace_context
tools.description: Read which GoodFolder, document, and Change Proposal the person currently has open.

tools.name: list_change_proposals
tools.description: List Change Proposals for the GoodFolder currently open, including their review status and affected documents.

status.description: Optional status: open, accepted, rejected, or needs-review.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List every file in the GoodFolder currently open, including which documents can be read or edited in the dashboard.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List the person's folders already connected to GoodFolder with protection status and when each was last saved. This dashboard cannot connect or save a local filesystem folder.

tools.name: preview_restore
tools.description: Preview going back to an earlier save: which files would be brought back. For one previewable file, use propose_restore_file to open a reviewable browser proposal; a connected computer can restore the whole folder. This never changes anything by itself.

number.description: The save number to go back to.

folder.description: Folder name. Leave off for the first folder.

tools.name: propose_document_change
tools.description: Compatibility alias for propose_file_change with the text_replace operation. This does not change the document; only the folder owner can accept it.

document.description: Document path in the current GoodFolder.

originalText.description: Exact current text, at most 20,000 characters.

explanation.description: Short reason for the suggestion, at most 500 characters.

tools.name: propose_document_media
tools.description: Create one reviewable Change Proposal that adds generated media and inserts its Markdown or HTML reference into a text document. The bytes wait outside the folder; accepting the whole proposal adds the media and edits the document in one Save. This never changes the folder by itself.

document.description: Exact path of the text document in the open GoodFolder.

assetPath.description: New path the image, video, or audio file will have if accepted, including its extension.

assetDataUrl.description: The generated image, video, or audio as a base64 data URL. Inline media is limited to 25 MB.

anchorText.description: Exact existing document text to anchor the insertion, at most 20,000 characters.

insertionText.description: Markdown or HTML that refers to assetPath, at most 20,000 characters.

placement.description: Put insertionText before or after anchorText.

section.description: Optional section name shown during review.

explanation.description: Why the media belongs here, at most 500 characters.

tools.name: propose_file_change
tools.description: Create a reviewable one-file suggestion. text_replace works on any file readable as text, source files included; table_update takes exact CSV/TSV cells; asset_replace puts a file somebody already sent up in place of this one. This never changes the file; only the folder owner can accept it.

document.description: Exact file path in the current GoodFolder.

section.description: Optional named section or context for a text replacement.

originalText.description: Exact current text for text_replace, at most 20,000 characters.

replacementText.description: Suggested text for text_replace, at most 20,000 characters.

changes.description: Exact CSV/TSV cell changes for table_update.

stagingAssetId.description: Short-lived temporary upload id for a later asset_replace operation.

mimeType.description: Uploaded asset MIME type for a later asset_replace operation.

extension.description: Uploaded asset extension for a later asset_replace operation.

explanation.description: Why the change is useful, at most 500 characters.

tools.name: propose_generated_file
tools.description: Create a reviewable DOCX, XLSX, PDF, PowerPoint, or bitmap image from structured content. The complete file waits outside the folder for the owner to preview and accept; this never changes the folder by itself.

path.description: New or existing path in the open GoodFolder, with a matching .docx, .xlsx, .pdf, .pptx, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, or .webp extension.

artifactType.description: Type of complete file to prepare.

content.description: Structured file content: blocks for document/PDF, sheets for spreadsheet, slides for presentation, or a PNG/JPEG/WebP dataUrl for image.

brand.description: Optional common brand kit with name, backgroundColor, accentColor, and a PNG/JPEG/WebP logoDataUrl returned by read_image.

explanation.description: Why this complete file was prepared, at most 500 characters.

tools.name: propose_new_goodfolder
tools.description: Prepare a reviewable request for a brand-new empty GoodFolder. The owner must accept it in the dashboard before any folder is created. Never use this for an existing local folder.

name.description: Name for the brand-new empty GoodFolder, at most 80 characters.

explanation.description: Why this new workspace is needed, at most 1,000 characters.

tools.name: propose_restore_file
tools.description: Prepare a reviewable replacement of one previewable file with its exact bytes from an earlier save. The folder changes only if its owner accepts the proposal.

path.description: Exact file path to bring back from the earlier save.

folder.description: Folder name. Leave off for the open folder.

tools.name: read_document_outline
tools.description: Read the headings and structure of the document currently open. This does not change the document.

tools.name: read_file_context
tools.description: Read a bounded line range from the open text file or a named text file. This never changes the file.

document.description: Optional file path; defaults to the file currently open.

lineCount.description: Number of lines, default 80 and at most 200.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a small image from the open GoodFolder as a data URL, so it can be used in a reviewable visual proposal. This never changes the folder.

path.description: Image path in the open GoodFolder.

tools.name: read_selected_text
tools.description: Read the passage the person has selected in the open document. Returns no text when there is no active selection.

tools.name: read_table_range
tools.description: Read a bounded, structured range from a CSV or TSV file, including cell addresses and values. This never changes the table.

document.description: Optional CSV or TSV path; defaults to the file currently open.

startRow.description: One-based first row, default 1 and at most 200.

startColumn.description: One-based first column, default 1 and at most 40.
